docuLanguageResource.title: Commission sends Statement of Objections to KKR for providing incorrect or misleading information during merger investigation
docuLanguageResource.subtitle: Commission sends Statement of Objections to KKR
docuLanguageResource.htmlContent:
The European Commission has informed KKR & Co. Inc. ('KKR') of its preliminary view that the company provided incorrect and/or misleading information during the 2024 Commission's investigation of KKR's acquisition of NetCo, under the EU Merger Regulation ('EUMR').

The merger investigation

On 19 April 2024, KKR notified the Commission of a proposed transaction.
